fieldNotes.truckGate: The plant's access drive connects to Niagara Way as a single open, uncontrolled driveway. No barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point visible in satellite imagery. The plant is set deep behind a tree screen so Street View (2025-05) cannot reach the entrance - hence medium confidence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth resolvable at the access drive. A small dark structure sits along the NE dock face but reads as a dock-side utility/canopy structure, not an entrance guard shack.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal access drive from Niagara Way curves to the NE dock face / drop yard; ample queue room for 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Drop yard along the NE side holds trailers parked nose-out plus dock-staged trailers; 50+ stalls.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long bank of dock doors along the NE building face with many trailers backed in; ~45 estimated, banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide open access drive and large paved apron with no existing control structure - physical room for a bypass lane.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Niagara acquired ~49 acres at Shenandoah Industrial Park; the developed/fenced footprint measures ~32 acres.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Located in the developed Shenandoah Industrial Park, Coweta County, on the south side of the Atlanta metro - surrounded by multiple large distribution warehouses. Called Urban.
